summary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, announcing the closing of a registered direct offering of 985,222 ordinary shares at $20.30 per share for approximately $20.0 million aggregate gross proceeds. The offering was led by a $19 million investment from a new institutional investor with participation from Univest Securities, LLC as sole placement agent. The shares were offered under an existing shelf registration statement on Form F-3. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
